free_tier.stated: A 20 GB / 7-day trial is advertised as free: 'We are happy to offer all first time users a free trial of 20GB, no credit card needed!'. The same trial is priced at EUR 3.90 in the plan table on the same page.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; the unit of retrieval is a Usenet article, ~750 KB by convention, so a 1 TiB month is roughly 1.4 million article fetches
per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: 3000+ days of binary and text retention, stated twice on the page

egress.terms: Unlimited downloads on every flat plan; speed and connections are tiered

interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563; no HTTP or object API exists for the download path, so a user drives it through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: A prepaid Abavia block stacks as fill under any primary and needs no renewal; the flats duplicate the XS News spool behind a lower speed ceiling.

limits.value: 10 connections on Flat Basic 20 up to 48 on Flat Unlimited
20 Mbit on Basic 20 up to unlimited on Flat Unlimited
blocks from 50 GB to 2000 GB, never expiring

limits_note: Flats: Basic 20 EUR 3.50/mo (20 Mbit, 10 connections), Premium 60 EUR 6.25, Ultimate 120 EUR 8.50, Stellar 160 EUR 8.75, Legacy 250 EUR 9.25, Flat Unlimited EUR 9.75 (48 connections). Blocks: 50 GB EUR 2.95, 100 GB EUR 4.95, 500 GB EUR 14.95, 1000 GB EUR 24.95, 2000 GB EUR 41.95, all 'Never Expires'. Payment: SEPA, card, iDEAL, Sofort, crypto, Bancontact, Belfius, Giropay and others.
binding_note: On the flats the speed tier binds before any volume, because downloads are unlimited; on the blocks the byte allowance is the whole product and a 2 TB block is 24 months at 1 TiB/month.

identity_cost.detail: The vendor says the 20 GB trial needs no credit card, but the plan card prices the same trial at EUR 3.90, so the honest reading is that something is charged. Crypto and SEPA are accepted for paid plans, which is the card-free route to a block.

reliability_note: The EUR 3.90 trial line and the 'no credit card needed' sentence are the kind of contradiction that costs a session if it is not recorded.
confidence_note: Every price is from the vendor page read today. The free-trial claim is contradicted by the same page's price table and is recorded as trial-only rather than free.

notes: Cheaper than its own parent brand at every block size except the 5 TB tier, which only XS News sells. Same shape as Blocknews with a published retention figure and a free 20 GB trial. Abandonment condition: if the block sentence acquires a time limit, the null becomes a number.
